note: Subnational geography of where it is thought to be. Estimates, signals and programme geographies — none of it a finding, all of it about places rather than countries.

projects.name: Bihar and eastern Uttar Pradesh
projects.desc: Brick kilns, stone quarries and agricultural bonded labour. One of the longest-running hotspot programmes anywhere. This is not an estimate and not a finding. It is a geography where a funder concentrated after its own assessment — someone looked hard and decided this is where to work. That makes it useful in a specific way: it marks places thought to matter enough to spend years on, which is different from places where something was recorded. The coordinate is the centre of a region, not a site.
